The '''FL-1 Load Lifter Droid''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] model that was used at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
